theme.rationale: Moving away from the generic 'AI-slop' dark cyberpunk theme towards an 'Editorial Art Gallery / Museum Display Case' identity. Collectibles are treated as premium art pieces. High contrast, vast negative space, intentional asymmetry, and tactile borders (21st.dev style). This makes the colorful products pop against a pristine architectural background.

headings.usage: Massive, architectural presence for hero text and section titles. Never center by default.

body.usage: Clean, highly legible text for descriptions, UI elements, and data.

mono_accents.usage: Tiny utility labels (e.g., ADVERTISEMENT, timestamps, stats) with uppercase and tracking-widest.

layout_and_spacing.philosophy: Generous spacing. Bento grids over standard columns. Use padding extensively (p-8 to p-12). Grid elements should feel like distinct glass cases in a museum.

surface_styles.default_card: bg-white border border-neutral-200 shadow-sm rounded-none md:rounded-lg overflow-hidden

ad_zones.philosophy: Ads must feel intentional, like high-end magazine placements, not bolted-on clutter.

zones.location: Top of page, below nav, above hero
zones.styling: bg-neutral-100 border border-dashed border-neutral-300 relative flex items-center justify-center mb-12
zones.label: Absolute top-left corner, text-[9px] uppercase tracking-[0.2em] text-neutral-400 bg-white/80 px-2 py-1

zones.location: Inserted every 6th card in the deal feed grid
zones.label: Top right pill: 'SPONSORED' in uppercase mono font, text-xs bg-white border border-neutral-200 px-2 py-1

zones.location: Right column on the Product Detail Page, below the 'Join Group' CTA block
zones.styling: bg-neutral-100 border border-dashed border-neutral-300 flex flex-col items-center justify-center
zones.label: text-[10px] tracking-widest text-neutral-400 mb-2 'ADVERTISEMENT'

zones.location: Directly above the main footer links
zones.styling: bg-neutral-900 border border-neutral-800 flex items-center justify-center mt-24 mb-12
zones.label: text-[10px] tracking-widest text-neutral-500 'ADVERTISEMENT'

deal_card.image_container: bg-neutral-100 p-6 flex items-center justify-center aspect-square relative group
deal_card.image_behavior: mix-blend-multiply (if white bg) or drop-shadow-xl. Hover: scale-105 transition-transform duration-500 ease-out
deal_card.badges: Absolute top-4 left-4. Discount badge uses brand_accent (bg-[#E54D2E] text-white px-3 py-1 text-sm font-bold)
deal_card.typography: Title: text-lg font-bold font-[Cabinet_Grotesk] tracking-tight leading-tight line-clamp-2. Price: text-2xl font-black text-neutral-900. Struck price: text-sm text-neutral-400 line-through.
deal_card.footer: flex justify-between items-center mt-2 pt-4 border-t border-neutral-100 text-sm text-neutral-500

hero.layout: Asymmetric Bento Grid (Mode A). Left side: Massive typography, value prop, CTA. Right side: A 3D-feeling layout of 2-3 overlapping top collectibles or a rotating showcase.
hero.typography: H1: text-5xl md:text-6xl lg:text-7xl font-black font-[Cabinet_Grotesk] leading-[0.9] tracking-tighter text-neutral-900.

header_nav.layout: Sticky top, crystal glassmorphism (glass_header style). Logo left (Cabinet Grotesk, font-black, text-2xl). Nav links center. 'Post Deal' CTA button right.

product_detail.layout: Grid cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-12 pt-8. Left (cols 7): Massive image gallery on gray backdrop. Right (cols 5): Sticky details, price, 'Join Group' CTA block, followed by sidebar_rail ad zone.

add_deal_modal.styling: Clean white modal, 1px neutral border, heavy shadow-2xl. Minimalist input fields (border-b only, or entirely rounded-lg shadcn inputs with subtle ring on focus). Focus state: ring-2 ring-[#E54D2E]/20 border-[#E54D2E].

motion_and_interaction.hover_states: Cards lift slightly (-translate-y-1) and cast a subtle shadow (shadow-lg) without changing border color. Images inside scale softly.
motion_and_interaction.page_transitions: Framer motion fade in and slide up (y: 20 -> 0, opacity: 0 -> 1) staggered for feed items.
motion_and_interaction.buttons: Primary CTA: bg-[#E54D2E] text-white hover:bg-[#C93C20] active:scale-95 transition-all.

testing_attributes.requirement: ALL interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute. Format: kebab-case, role-based.

images.description: Premium Goku action figure photography for hero section

instructions_to_main_agent: Discard the old cyberpunk/neon theme entirely.
Implement the 'Museum / Display Case' light theme. Ensure vast negative space and precise padding.
Integrate the ad zones exactly as specified under 'ad_zones' property. They must be visible placeholders for the user to inject real ads later.

Use Cabinet Grotesk for headings and Satoshi for body (import via Fontshare or Google Fonts equivalents if needed, or stick strictly to local/custom CSS imports). If unavailable, use Clash Display or General Sans.
Ensure all components (especially Shadcn ones) are stripped of their default 'Vercel' look and customized to fit the high-contrast, subtle-border design guidelines.
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes.
